remarks: Welcome to your new home...this updated 4 BR split-level home is set on 1/3 acre in desirable mid-Ridges. Enjoy sitting in your living room, by the lovely stone fireplace. Your beautiful newer granite kitchen has imported tile backsplash and brand new stainless steel appliances. Enjoy your relaxing, sunny family room--or entertain on your oversized deck in your elevated, private back yard. This home has two bedrooms on the main level and a half bath. In the upper level, you will find two additional bedrooms with plenty of closet space and a beautiful full bath with wainscoting. New roof, leaf gutter system and sump pump. Come to see this great home in wonderful neighborhood - you won't be disappointed!
